description: Dispatches a keyboard key with optional modifiers to the page or a resolved target. If it triggers a page alert, it is handled without creating an interactive dialog and the success feedback reports the alert message. If it opens a confirm, prompt, or beforeunload dialog, the action returns its dialog id and directs the caller to Page.handleDialog; if it activates a file chooser, the native chooser is cancelled automatically and the prompt directs the caller to direct File.handleChooser injection.

pageId.description: Page ID that should receive the key press.

key.description: Key value to press, such as "Enter", "Escape", or "a".

modifiers.description: Optional modifier keys held while pressing the main key.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to focus before pressing the key.

id.description: Optional canonical element ID to focus before pressing the key.

purpose.description: Describe why this key is needed, e.g., pressing Enter to submit, Escape to close an overlay, Tab to move focus, or a shortcut with modifiers

target.description: Target identity used for the key dispatch.

resolvedBy.description: Actor or resolution mode that selected the target.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used by the action.

dialog.description: Interactive native dialog returned by this key press; handled page alerts are not returned here.

id.description: ID of an interactive native dialog returned for Page.handleDialog.

message.description: Dialog message supplied by the page.

defaultValue.description: Default value for a prompt dialog.

truncated.description: Whether native dialog text was truncated.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.
